author: Inside Edition
description: Detectives are going door to door along a road close to Nancy Guthrie's house seeking video from home security cameras. They are asking homeowners for video from the night of January 11 between 9 p.m. and midnight, three weeks before Guthrie was taken. Authorities believe the kidnappers may have been probing the neighborhood. Authorities are also asking for video from January 31, the night Guthrie was taken.
title: Investigators Seek Security Footage In Nancy Guthrie's Kidnapping Case

author: Inside Edition
description: An outpouring of love came for "Dawson's Creek" star James Van Der Beek, who spent his final days in hospice care as close friends visited him to say goodbye. Van Der Beek achieved fame and, by most standards, was a wealthy man from his early days on "Dawson's Creek" to competing on "Dancing With The Stars" in 2019. However, it has been revealed that his wife Kimberly and their children are struggling financially. Friends have set up a GoFundMe page to assist the family.
title: Outpouring Of Love For The Late James Van Der Beek

author: Inside Edition
description: When the masked man walked to Nancy Guthrie's doorway, apparently no one heard anything. A guard dog may have changed that. In a demonstration done for Inside Edition, Everest the dog went bananas when a man played an intruder. Everest is Jane Dorian's dog. She lives in Beverly Hills and says her German shepherd makes her feel safe. Mike Israeli owns Delta K-9 Academy and trains Everest. There has also been a surge in the purchase of home security cameras.
title: Can Guard Dogs Help Keep You Safe From An Intruder?

author: Inside Edition
description: This house-turned-museum in New York City has been keeping a secret. The Merchant's House Museum believes this passageway, hidden in a dresser, was a stop on the Underground Railroad. They tell WCBS at the time, even some northern states weren't safe for those escaping slavery. Directors say they recently discovered that the home's architect and its first occupant was an abolitionist named Joseph Brewster. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Secret Passageway In NYC Museum May Have Been Part Of Underground Railroad

author: Inside Edition
description: Blake Lively and Justin Baldoni arrived in Federal Court in New York City for a court-ordered settlement conference. It's the first time they have come face-to-face since the start of their blockbuster legal battle.
title: Blake Lively And Justin Baldoni Appear In Federal Court #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: This performer's side show didn't go over so well. The Commerce City Police Department in Colorado released video of the act, performed at a busy intersection. A fire-juggling unicyclist would normally be an impressive site, but cops say the bit was illegal because it's considered trespassing.
title: Fire-Juggling Unicyclist Warned By Police For Performing At Busy Intersection #shorts
